sensitivity.title: Forecast scenarios
trustScore.label: Forecast confidence
modeBadge.pure_transfer.label: Pure Transfer
modeBadge.pure_transfer.explanation: Forecast built on proxy brand data with your launch parameters applied. This is Aurora Launch's primary mode — maximum accuracy, no compromises.
modeBadge.transfer_bias.label: Transfer + Bias Check
modeBadge.transfer_bias.explanation: Base forecast enhanced with a check against your brand's available data. Aurora flags a warning if the gap exceeds 30%.
modeBadge.ols_priors.label: OLS + Priors (simplified)
modeBadge.ols_priors.explanation: Aurora uses a proxy-based forecast. Extended regression mode arrives in the next update. Confidence intervals are slightly wider — the forecast is ready for decision-making.
modeBadge.bayesian_priors.label: Bayesian + Priors (simplified)
modeBadge.bayesian_priors.explanation: Aurora builds the forecast from proxy brand data. Full Bayesian mode with your historical data arrives in the next update. The forecast is reliable — precision increases with the update.
onboarding.tutorial.slide1.title: Forecasting a new brand launch
onboarding.tutorial.slide1.body: Aurora Launch Planner builds a sales forecast for a brand with no data yet, using a similar brand as a proxy.
onboarding.tutorial.slide2.title: Loading data
onboarding.tutorial.slide2.body: Load XLSX from Econometrica, .aurora files from Aurora Data Studio, or connect to your enterprise data sources.
onboarding.tutorial.slide3.title: Forecast and confidence
onboarding.tutorial.slide3.body: Aurora calculates a point forecast and a range of likely outcomes. The Trust score summarises reliability as a single number from 0 to 100.
onboarding.tutorial.slide4.title: Sensitivity scenarios
onboarding.tutorial.slide4.body: One click gives three scenarios: pessimistic, base, optimistic. Advanced mode unlocks 6 additional parameters.
onboarding.tutorial.slide5.title: Methodology certificate
onboarding.tutorial.slide5.body: Every forecast is signed with Ed25519. Verify independently at verify.auroraai.pro — the algorithm is public.

refresh.banner.aria_label: New data available for forecast refresh
refresh.banner.available: New data available for {count} project(s). Refresh forecasts?
refresh.optin.title: Automatic forecast refresh
refresh.optin.detail: Got a fresh DSM/Mediascope export? Aurora can watch your folders and offer to refresh the forecast — so you see the current picture without manually checking files. Everything stays on your machine, nothing goes to the cloud. Change your mind? Toggle off in Settings (152-FZ / PDPL compliant).
refresh.settings.title: Automatic forecast refresh
refresh.settings.detail: Aurora watches only the folders you choose and prompts you to refresh forecasts when new files appear there. No network requests, no data transmission — everything local. Turn off any time (152-FZ / PDPL compliant).
